## Description

The description the MCP server sends to the model, word for word. Its rules apply to every call.

> Check how many more notes the user is allowed to schedule on their current plan. Returns maxScheduledNotes (the plan limit), currentScheduledCount, remaining (how many more they may schedule right now), and unlimited (true = the user has the Unlimited Schedules addon and there is no limit). ALWAYS call this before schedule_notes or schedule_notes_with_custom_dates, and NEVER schedule more notes than `remaining` unless unlimited is true.

## Arguments

This tool takes no arguments.
